description: Header file defining memory management functions and macros for a specific context, including initialization, cleanup, allocation, reallocation, string duplication, and formatted string allocation, with project-specific memory handling macros.

methods.name: dmfree
methods.description: Frees memory pointed to by m.

methods.name: dm_init_mem
methods.description: Initializes memory management for the given context.

methods.name: dm_clean_mem
methods.description: Cleans up memory management for the given context.

methods.name: dm_malloc
methods.description: Allocates a memory block of specified size within the context.

methods.name: dm_calloc
methods.description: Allocates and zero-initializes an array of n elements of given size within the context.

methods.name: dm_realloc
methods.description: Resizes a memory block to a new size within the context.

methods.name: dm_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string within the context.

methods.name: dm_asprintf
methods.description: Allocates a formatted string within the context.
